question: A dealer had 120 kg of wheat. A part of it was sold by him at 10% gain and the rest at 25% gain. overall, he had a gain of 15%. How much of the wheat was sold at 10% gain?
solution:
**GIVEN:**

Total quantity of wheat = 120kg

a part was sold = 10% gain

rest part = 25% gain

overall gain = 15%

**FORMULA USED:**

S.P. = [( 100 +Gain%) /100] × C.P. Where S.P. = Selling price and C.P. = Cost price.

**CALCULATION:**

Let Cost price of 1kg wheat be Rs100.

Selling price of 1 kg wheat sold at 10% gain = 110/100 × 100 = Rs110.

Selling price of 1 kg wheat sold at 25% gain = 125 /100 × 100 = Rs125.

Average selling price of 1 kg wheat = 115 /1
